newsitem.title: USA: Lucent sues AMP in patent dispute.
newsitem.headline: Lucent sues AMP in patent dispute.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc has sued AMP Inc, alleging AMP has infringed a patent for a connector assembly originally developed when Lucent was part of AT&T Corp predecessor American Telephone and Telegraph Co.

In papers filed in the U.S. District Court in Delaware Monday, Lucent also alleges that AMP, through its Whitaker Corp subsidiary, "obtained European patents claiming Lucent's intellectual property, thereby wrongfully converting Lucent's property to themselves."
Lucent seeks unspecified damages, any royalties related to the European patents, and a court order requiring AMP to assign the European patents to Lucent.

AMP is a Harrisburg, Pennsylvania-based producer of electrical and electronic connection devices with 215 sites in 44 countries. Lucent, formed in AT&T's restructuring, is a communications systems and software provider based in Murray Hill, New Jersey.
An AMP spokeswoman said the company did not comment on pending litigation.
